name: CBT Account Already Exists
subject: You already have an account with this email
response_html:
Hi,

Someone, most likely you, just tried to create a new account with {{ email }}, but an account with this address already exists. Nothing was changed.

Log in with your existing password, or reset your password if you have forgotten it.

If this was not you, you can ignore this message. Nobody can get into your account from it.
